title: Python WorkSpace
summary: A personal collection of miscellaneous Python projects and experiments, including a SyntheticDataProject that trains a synthesizer on tabular data and evaluates its quality. It uses SDV's single-table API, calling CTGANSynthesizer to train a model and evaluate_quality to score the synthetic output against real data.
evidence: SyntheticDataProject/train_Data.py: 'model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=10, verbose=True)'; sdv_quality_Report.py imports evaluate_quality
